name: RIWF E1 v2 confirmatory plan

pilots.gate: mean within-world spread of refit target success across candidates at least 0.20
pilots.result: q_common 0.95 spread 0.27, q_common 0.45 spread 0.13, demand-shift new-test spread 0.25. Passed on the mean. Target delays moved from 12-28 to 40-80 and rare share from 0.10-0.25 to 0.05-0.30 after the first pilot showed source validation at the oracle.

environment.tests: three balanced binary tests that separate all four classes, permuted per world
environment.demand_shift: candidates train and are scored on test 1 at every gate. Deployment asks tests 1, 2 and 3. Endpoint uses tests 2 and 3.

pool.main: GRU, LSTM x width 16, 64 x training delays 3-7, 3-14, 3-28 x rare share natural or 0.5, snapshots at updates 75 and 150: 48 encoders
pool.ds: GRU, LSTM x width 16, 64 x auxiliary last-cue head off or on x rare share natural or 0.5, training delays 3-7, snapshots at 75 and 150: 32 encoders
pool.quantisers: per encoder, five allocations of six states between rare and common regimes (5+1, 4+2, 3+3, 2+4, 1+5), k-means on standardised source memories
pool.memory: hidden state one step before the first gate

admission: an encoder is admitted when its native success on held-out source episodes is within 0.10 of the best encoder in its world. Its five quantisations are admitted with it. The rule uses source data only.

teachers.primary: set pooling network (sum of per-step embeddings plus regime flag), trained on cal source episodes
teachers.second: GRU sequence network trained on cal source episodes
teachers.reference: analytic symmetric-noise posterior with cue reliabilities estimated on cal source episodes, plus log-posterior noise 0.5, 1 and 2 for the teacher-error test

quantised.k_delta_set: min, freedom deficit of the lookup table with success weights |2p-1| on the known tests
quantised.k_rho_set: min, freedom deficit with normalised-regret weights
quantised.f_ign: min, ignorance-prior freedom deficit over all seven binary tests with success weights
quantised.f_unw: min, unweighted freedom deficit over all seven tests
quantised.k_deploy: min, freedom deficit on the deployment tests (demand-shift reference, uses the test list)
quantised.ll: min, teacher log loss of the cell-pooled posterior
quantised.val: max, source validation success of the source-fitted lookup policy
quantised.skd: min, source freedom deficit with teacher weights on held-out source episodes
quantised.k_delta_seq, k_delta_an, k_delta_n0.5, k: min, K_delta under the other teachers

native.lin: min, cross-fitted freedom deficit of the linear readout language on panel memories
native.knn: min, cross-fitted deficit of a 15-nearest-neighbour readout
native.tpe: min, teacher-based policy evaluation of the native actor on the panel
native.mp: max, mean maximum action probability at the gates
native.ent: min, mean action entropy at the gates
native.atc: max, average thresholded confidence with source threshold
native.dis: min, disagreement with the pool majority
native.slin: min, linear-language deficit on source episodes

selectors.references: uniform random (pool mean) and target oracle, computed after opening

modes.refit_lookup: lookup table refitted on the panel with teacher answers, endpoint q_succ
modes.refit_linear: linear readout refitted on the panel, endpoint l_succ

hypotheses.H1: ds60: f_ign beats k_delta_set on new-test refit success (q_succ), and k_delta_set wins or ties on the known test (q_succ_known). Paired sign-flip and crossover interaction with bootstrap interval.
hypotheses.H2: main: after refitting, k_delta_set (q_succ) and lin (l_succ) beat nat_val or val and each teacher-free selector. Paired sign-flip per rival, Holm within family, one-sided alpha 0.05.
hypotheses.H3: main: realised regret after linear refit (bayes - l_succ) tracks lin with slope near 1 within worlds, and lin selection beats knn selection on l_succ.
hypotheses.H4: main: tpe wins as-is (n_succ) and lin wins after refitting (l_succ). Selector x mode interaction with bootstrap interval.
hypotheses.H5: main: gain of k_delta_set over k_unit_set in q_succ rises as q_common falls. One-sided trend test across strata.
hypotheses.H6: main60 and main45: k_rho_set selection wins on normalised regret (q_nreg) and k_delta_set wins on success (q_succ_r vs q_succ). Difference in differences with bootstrap interval.
hypotheses.H7: main: panel selection loss under each teacher stays within 2 eps, eps the measured teacher error.
hypotheses.H8: main: zero-reward selection matches online validation at some n episodes per candidate.
hypotheses.H9: main: states allocated to the rare regime by weighted selection match the oracle, unweighted selection allocates fewer.

endpoints: target expected success of the deployed agent per world, reported raw and as gap closure between admitted-pool mean and target oracle

stats.signflip: exact up to 24 worlds, one million draws above
stats.tail: share of worlds where a selector deploys a candidate from the bottom quartile of target success
